title: Continuous inhomogeneous unit two-cocycle classes
statement: Let K be any field, Ks its separable closure, G = Gal(Ks/K) with the Krull topology, and M = Additive(Ksˣ) with the discrete topology and natural action [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology]. Define Z²_cont(G,M) to consist of continuous c : G × G → M satisfying g • c(h,i) - c(gh,i) + c(g,hi) - c(g,h) = 0 for all g,h,i. Define c ~ d iff there is continuous b : G → M with d(g,h) = c(g,h) + g • b(h) - b(gh) + b(g). The relation is reflexive by zero, symmetric by negation and transitive by addition. GaloisUnitsTwoCocycleClasses K is the quotient Z²_cont(G,M)/~.
